title: Spiced Lassi Panna Cotta
description: A creamy Indian dessert made with lassi, topped with chewy morbier crumbles and aromatic spices.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the lassi, sugar, and salt. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar dissolves.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until it thickens slightly.
Remove the mixture from the heat and stir in the aromatic spice blend.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or until chilled.
Just before serving, crumble the morbier cheese into small pieces and sprinkle over the top of each serving.
